description: Eight buttons in 4HP, each raising a gate at its own jack, with an All button and a polyphonic jack carrying all eight

params.text: Acts on all eight sections at once, toggling them unless the menu is set to force them all on or all off
Raises the gate at the jack beside it while it is held, or holds it until the next press when its latch button is on
Makes the button beside it a toggle, one press taking the gate high and the next taking it low, in place of a gate that lasts while the button is held

outputs.text: Carries one channel per section, each with that section's gate
Carries 10V while the button beside it is down or latched on, and 0V otherwise

notes: this module has no clipping range set by default, because its outputs only ever carry the two gate levels from the menu
menu: All-button mode: All OFF, All ON, Toggle ALL — chooses what the All button does to the eight sections
Set gate-buttons 1-8: Latched, Unlatched — sets all eight latch buttons at once
Poly output channels: 1 (monophonic) up to 8 channels — sets how many of the eight sections the POLY jack carries, 8 unless you reduce it
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
